data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that highlights characters or words in a text based on patterns or word lists.
data.what_it_does: HighlightText displays a string and applies a different style to parts that match a regular‑expression pattern or a list of words. It supports case‑sensitivity, full‑word detection and custom text styles for both normal and highlighted portions.
use_when: You need simple inline highlighting of numbers, keywords, or custom patterns in static text.
You want a lightweight solution without pulling in a full rich‑text editor.
avoid_when: You require interactive editing or selection of highlighted text.
You need complex rich‑text features like embedded widgets or markdown rendering.
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget
weaknesses: Limited to highlighting only, no editing capabilities
May have performance impact on very large texts
No built‑in support for tap callbacks on highlighted spans
